title: AI Innovators Flock to Oracle (PR Newswire, Oracle, 2024-03-18)
notes: Oracle PR (Mar 18, 2024). Suno chose OCI Supercluster to train its music models (Mikey Shulman quote). Modal leveraged OCI Compute bare metal for multi-cloud inference. Earliest public confirmation of Suno-on-OCI. Region-agnostic; Supercluster = Abilene, TX (172).
